summary: Rabbi Soffer discusses Masekhet Arachin daf 6, examining whether donations from a Goy are accepted for the Bet HaMikdash or a Bet Knesset. He details whether a person who sets aside money for Sedaka is allowed to use it for himself or another person and pay it back later. He also explores the Mishna concerning vows of Erekh for a Goses and someone who is Yose Lahareg.
